career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Examination begin in administrative, police, and finance cadres as Deputy Collectors / Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDM), Deputy Superintendents of Police (DSP), or State Tax Officers. Administrative officers progress through state executive hierarchy before being inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) or Indian Police Service (IPS) under the state promotion quota.

exam_scheme.note: The Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Examination is conducted under The Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Examination Rules, 2021 (with 1st Amendment 2021 and 2nd Amendment 2023) in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (2 objective papers of 200 marks each, 400 marks total), Main Examination (6 compulsory conventional descriptive papers totaling 1,050 marks; Paper I is qualifying 100 marks, leaving 950 marks for merit), and Personality Test / Interview (100 marks), leading to a grand total merit out of 1,050 marks.

stages.source_label: JPSC Combined Civil Services Examination Advt. No. 01/2024 & CCSE Syllabus

papers.paper_name: General Studies Paper-I (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science & Tech, Jharkhand Awareness, Current Events)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (100 questions of 2 marks each; no penalty for wrong answers)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Screening test to shortlist candidates 15 times the total number of vacancies category-wise. Marks do not count for final merit.

papers.paper_name: General Studies Paper-II (Jharkhand Specific History, Culture, Land Laws CNT/SPT, Geography, Economy, Policies & Schemes)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (100 questions of 2 marks each; no penalty for wrong answers)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Combined aggregate of Paper I and Paper II (out of 400) determines qualification for Mains shortlist in the ratio of 1:15 of vacancies.

stages.source_label: JPSC Combined Civil Services Examination Advt. No. 01/2024 & CCSE Rules

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Hindi & General English (50 marks Hindi + 50 marks English)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying paper only; minimum 30 marks out of 100 required. Marks are NOT added to aggregate marks for Interview or Final Merit List.

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Language and Literature (One selected from 15 approved regional/tribal/classical languages)
Paper III: Social Sciences (History & Geography, equal weightage)
Paper IV: Indian Constitution & Polity, Public Administration & Good Governance
Paper V: Indian Economy, Globalization and Sustainable Development
Paper VI: General Sciences, Environment & Technology Development

stages.source_label: JPSC Combined Civil Services Advt. No. 01/2024 & CCSE Rules 2021

papers.qualifying_threshold: No minimum qualifying marks in interview (rule amended by Jharkhand Combined Civil Services Examination Rules 2021). Marks are added to written merit score (950) for final ranking out of 1,050 marks.

financial_package.note: Pay figures shown for premier Level 9 administrative postings (Jharkhand Administrative Service Deputy Collector, Jharkhand Police Service DSP, Jharkhand Finance Service State Tax Officer). Placement follows the Jharkhand State Revised Pay Rules Level 9 (PB-2 ₹9,300–34,800 with Grade Pay ₹5,400, entry basic pay ₹53,100).
financial_package.pay_source_label: JPSC Advt. No. 01/2024 & Jharkhand State Revised Pay Rules Level 9
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from Level 9 entry basic ₹53,100 + 58% DA (₹30,798) + state HRA (8%–18% depending on posting location in Ranchi/Jamshedpur/Dhanbad or district headquarters) + medical allowance (₹1,000) + transport allowance. In-hand estimate accounts for statutory deductions of 10% NPS on Basic + DA (₹8,390), professional tax, and GIS.
official_perks: Government designated residential accommodation / official quarters in district posting
Official vehicle with driver and fuel quota for administrative field duty
Medical reimbursement facilities under Jharkhand State Health Scheme
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and earned leave encashment benefits
Security protection personnel and administrative office support staff
Subsidized electricity, telephone, and official communication allowances
